whatItIs: Stim is an open-source project in the error correction and mitigation category. It is maintained by quantumlib and primarily looks like a C++ codebase. A fast stabilizer circuit library.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches error correction and mitigation workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: High-performance simulation of quantum stabilizer circuits for quantum error correction. ◼︎︎  What is Stim?
